label: Week 39, 2026
recap:
Week 39, 2026 was a quiet week for legislative movement, with two bill movements recorded across two jurisdictions. California and the District of Columbia each had one movement. The California record involved infrastructure and energy and transparency and disclosure, while the District of Columbia record involved health care. No unthemed bills were recorded.

Litigation accounted for most of the activity, with five case updates. Federal documents were absent, and no agency activity appeared in the data. The overall shape was limited, with a small number of legislative changes and a modest set of court updates.
